rationale: Three issues: (1) Integration test deleted two valid behavioral assertions the plan explicitly said to keep; (2) no test covers the empty→hasHistory re-key transition; (3) reviewer flagged defaultSize/minSize pixel semantics (subsequently confirmed correct per library source — numeric values are pixels in react-resizable-panels v4).

findings.title: Integration test lost chat-history and chat-prompt assertions
findings.description: Two assertions removed without replacement. Plan stated queryByTestId('chat-history').not.toBeInTheDocument() remains valid.
findings.resolution: Added queryAllByTestId('chat-history').toHaveLength(1) — distinguishes panel-only (empty state) from panel+content (history state) despite library mapping id→data-testid.

findings.title: No test for empty→hasHistory transition (Group re-key logic)
findings.description: The re-keying from empty-{userId} to {userId} on first message was untested.
findings.resolution: Added transition test that mutates history from [] to non-empty, rerenders, and asserts separator stays and chat-history appears.

findings.title: defaultSize=130 / minSize=130 query about percentage vs pixel
findings.description: Reviewer flagged these as >100% percentages. Pre-existing code.
findings.resolution: Confirmed via library source (case 'number': return [e, 'px']) that numeric values are treated as pixels in react-resizable-panels v4. No change needed.
